title: 🎬 HEAVEN HEADQUARTERS
paragraphs:
🎬 HEAVEN HEADQUARTERS
Heaven isn’t a hobby — it’s headquarters.
I’m not off-duty. I’m on assignment. 💥
Every sunrise is a briefing. Every breath is a mission.
This is not leisure — this is calling. ⚔️🔥
📖 Verse: “Put on the full armor of God, so that you can take your stand against the devil’s schemes.” — Ephesians 6:11
